description: This Kotlin file defines a Fragment for an Android application that displays details of a movie, including title, poster, and synopsis. It also provides a button to rate the movie, which opens a rating dialog. The fragment initializes and uses a RatingViewModel to handle rating-related data and interactions, and loads an image from a URL using Glide.

classes.name: DetailsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that shows detailed information about a movie, including title, poster, synopsis, and a button to rate the movie.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, loads movie data based on 'groupId', and launches a coroutine to prepare rating data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies the view binding to avoid memory leaks when the view is destroyed.
